messages.content: I'll definitely let you know how it works out. I've got a few other small things I'm trying too, like shading the most vulnerable ones with a cloth during the hottest part of the day. It's all just little steps, but I guess that's what matters.

Sounds like a good strategy! Shading those vulnerable plants is smart, especially during the heat. It sounds like you're being very careful with your garden! Let me know how those extra plants do after you've tried the compost!
How about we check the soil moisture in a few of the pots tomorrow? I'm curious if the compost is making a difference in how quickly they dry out.
That sounds like a great idea. Checking the soil moisture levels daily is a great way to see how the compost is affecting the plants. Just let me know if you see any big changes!
Sure, I'll do that. I'll also try to check a few pots today to see if there's any noticeable difference in the soil texture. Maybe that'll give us a better idea of what to look for tomorrow.
